steps.prompt: Underline the sizing INPUT in: minimum EGC for a circuit protected by a 60A breaker, aluminum conductors
steps.teach: Table 250.122 keys off the rating of the overcurrent device AHEAD of the circuit, not the ampacity of the conductor it protects. Ampacity is a Table 310.16 question, not this one.

steps.prompt: Which tab family holds this table?
steps.teach: Table 250.122 lives under this one tab every time, no matter which specific question you're asked about it.

steps.prompt: Underline which COLUMN of the table you would read for aluminum conductors
steps.teach: Table 250.122 has separate copper vs. aluminum/copper-clad-aluminum columns. Reading the wrong column for the stated material is a classic miss. Check the column header before you lock a number.

steps.prompt: Open the footnote / notes habit zone before you answer.
steps.teach: Table 250.122 carries its own notes, including how to handle conductors installed in parallel. Check them before you commit to a number.
